recall_findings.prompt:
Draft iteration {iteration} of 6. You are writing {doc_type} documentation.

Full outline:
{doc_outline}

Pick the section to write for iteration {iteration}. The outline has 6 major sections — write them in order. Reply with ONLY the section name.

write_section.prompt:
Write the following section of {doc_type} documentation for {project_path}:

Section: {section_pick}

Documentation outline:
{doc_outline}

Relevant code analysis from memory:
{section_findings}

Write a complete, polished draft of this section. Follow technical documentation best practices:
- Use code blocks with language hints for all code examples
- Include function signatures with parameter types and return types
- Add inline comments explaining non-obvious behavior
- Use tables for configuration options and parameters
- Cross-reference related sections

Use markdown formatting.

store_draft.prompt:
Draft iteration {iteration} of 6 complete. Section written: {section_pick}

If iteration is less than 6, reply YES to continue. If iteration is 6, reply NO — all sections are drafted.
